test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'GOAL' is coded as '917314', and 'PBKS' is coded as '1841321'. How will 'HAMD' be coded in that language?
solution:
The alphabets and their positions are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cbc5c097aeb98a48b72ad50b9d4e29b952906e3f76fa5d128ba82d4b9289f2b.png] 

For 'GOAL' is coded as '917314'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdf57f3f62e6cb553eb29a2e7e1b156f66261da558cbbb24f057871babcd1e22.png] 

And 'PBKS' is coded as '1841321'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dc7e9281265dcb56ece125bd5e02d2af83e2fdd06b91405fd3cb395fd25b677.png] 

Similarly for the word 'HAMD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c9c6850aed210f429a4c9c1c44d8ff2a203d6e48d0994bca4176a547d0cdcf4.png] 

Thus, the 'HAMD' will be coded as '**103156**'.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.
